story.titleZh: 安东内利踏上美墨巴赛事之旅，有望成为史上最年轻F1世界冠军
story.summaryZh: 安东内利即将在美国、墨西哥和巴西的赛事中挑战成为史上最年轻F1世界冠军，他如何保持谦逊？通过赛前洗车。
story.originalTitle: When Kimi Antonelli left home for this next run of races in the US, Mexico and Brazil, it was highly likely he’d next return as the youngest F1 world...
story.summaryEn:
When Kimi Antonelli left home for this next run of races in the US, Mexico and Brazil, it was highly likely he’d next return as the youngest F1 world champion in history
So how does he stay grounded? By washing his car before leaving: https://racer.com/2026/10/19/how-antonelli-handles-standing-on-the-verge-of-f1-history #F1
detailZh:
当安东内利离开家前往美国、墨西哥和巴西的下一轮赛事时，他很可能将成为历史上最年轻的F1世界冠军。
那么他是如何保持谦逊的呢？通过在离开前洗车：https://racer.com/2026/10/19/how-安东内利-handles-standing-on-the-verge-of-f1-history #F1
detailEn:
When Kimi Antonelli left home for this next run of races in the US, Mexico and Brazil, it was highly likely he’d next return as the youngest F1 world champion in history
So how does he stay grounded? By washing his car before leaving: https://racer.com/2026/10/19/how-antonelli-handles-standing-on-the-verge-of-f1-history #F1
story.leadZh: 安东内利即将在美国、墨西哥和巴西的赛事中挑战成为史上最年轻F1世界冠军，他如何保持谦逊？通过赛前洗车。
bodyZh: 安东内利即将在美国、墨西哥和巴西的赛事中挑战成为史上最年轻F1世界冠军，他如何保持谦逊？通过赛前洗车。

relatedItems.summaryZh: 哈贾尔因今日 paddock 事件被召唤至 stewards，涉嫌不当行为。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Isack Hadjar has also been summoned to the stewards tomorrow morning for “misconduct relating to an incident in the Formula 1 paddock today” Hadjar ...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
Isack Hadjar has also been summoned to the stewards tomorrow morning for “misconduct relating to an incident in the Formula 1 paddock today”
Hadjar pushed a fan who had tried to put an arm round him and take a selfie as he was walking to the garage #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
哈贾尔 也被要求明天早上到 stewards 处接受询问，原因是“今天在 Formula 1 操场发生的违规事件”
哈贾尔 推开了一名试图绕到他身边拍照的粉丝，当时他正在走向维修区 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailEn:

relatedItems.summaryZh: 汉密尔顿在FP2中被告知停止赛车，此前维斯塔潘与劳森发生接触，同时博尔特洛托因技术问题停留在维修区。

relatedItems.summaryEn: Virtual Safety Car as Hamilton is told to stop on track in FP2. That follows contact between Verstappen and Lawson earlier, and a technical issue that's keeping Bortoleto in the garage #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 虚拟安全车启动，因为汉密尔顿在FP2练习中被告知在赛道上停车。这发生在维斯塔潘和劳森之前的接触之后，以及一个让博特洛托留在维修区的问题。#F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn: Virtual Safety Car as Hamilton is told to stop on track in FP2. That follows contact between Verstappen and Lawson earlier, and a technical issue that's keeping Bortoleto in the garage #F1 #MexicoGP

relatedItems.titleZh: FIA确认赫塔尚未获得超级驾照，需额外积分
relatedItems.summaryZh: FIA确认赫塔尚未获得超级驾照，需额外积分；IndyCar网站曾错误地将他列为2025年P6，实际为P7；FP1后他拥有39个SL积分。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Confirmation from the FIA that Colton Herta doesn't have his Super License yet, and he needs another point There was an error on the IndyCar website a...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
Confirmation from the FIA that Colton Herta doesn't have his Super License yet, and he needs another point
There was an error on the IndyCar website at some point that put him in P6 in 2025 when he was actually P7. He has 39 SL points now after today's FP1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
FIA确认赫塔尚未获得超级驾照，他需要额外积分。
在某个时刻，IndyCar网站上出现了一个错误，将赫塔列为2025年的P6，但实际上他是P7。
FP1后，赫塔现在拥有39个SL积分。
#F1 #MexicoGP
detailEn:
Confirmation from the FIA that Colton Herta doesn't have his Super License yet, and he needs another point
There was an error on the IndyCar website at some point that put him in P6 in 2025 when he was actually P7. He has 39 SL points now after today's FP1 #F1 #MexicoGP
